player_prompt.intro:
D nek d Amenzu {player_id} deg umenẓad n GameOfPureStrategy.
- Ṭṭefḍ 13 n tkeṛḍis A-K; yal yiwen yettwasqedac kan waḥd.
- Deg krayat, takert n tkeṛḍist n tjaza tban. Aẓeḍ kan waḥd n tkeṛḍist s tira n yal yiwen aydeg llan kra n token ibawen am '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Tkeṛḍist tameqqrant tareḥ tajaza (akken ma llan ṣifṛa n ṣṣenf). Tifrat ṭṭfen tajaza deg ṣṣenf i krayat d-iteddun.
- Aṭṭas ameqqran akked 13 n krayat iṛumḍen.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aseḍruṣ aɣiwel ad ilɣen kan waḥd n token n tkeṛḍist ibawen.
